workload_work_year_days_001.evidence: Members of the Teachers’ Unit, except counselors and librarians, shall work one hundred and eighty-seven (187) days.

workload_workday_length_002.evidence: The workday of a teacher shall be Seven (7) hours and 35 minutes Monday through Friday

workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: The teacher shall have a twenty-five (25) minute preparation time at the beginning of each student day unless supervision is needed.

workload_prep_minutes_004.evidence: The teacher shall have a twenty-five (25) minute preparation time at the beginning of each student day... The full-time teacher shall have a minimum of 250 minutes of on-site individual planning time each week.

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: Principals may meet an individual during their plan time no more than two times per week to: (a)To discuss an observation or evaluation (b)To discuss a performance issue (c)To meet with the IEP team, if needed

workload_lunch_duty_free_006.evidence: The teacher shall have a (30) thirty-minute duty-free lunch period.
